titulo: The WhatsApp button that brings you inquiries
hooks: How many forget to message you?
Your bare number is costing you inquiries
One tap and they're already messaging you
voz: If messaging you means copying your number, saving it and finding it in WhatsApp, plenty of people leave it for later. And later never comes. With a button, the chat opens with a message already written. They tap, send, and you reply with the question already there.

visual.texto: So they leave it for later
The full question lands with you

captions: Every step your customer has to take to message you is an excuse not to. A WhatsApp button on your website takes all those steps off their plate.
The button can open the chat with a message already written, like 'Hi, I'd like to book Saturday.' Your customer just taps send.
If your number is buried at the bottom of the page in tiny print, you're losing inquiries you'll never even see.
